frozen_candidate_root_contribution: lEn = an authoritative act (verb) — or its resulting enduring state (noun laEnat) — of consigning/branding a target as cut off and cast out: repudiated and driven from favour, solidarity, support and (God's) mercy, and thereby left unsupported and marked. The same relation is realized at varying efficacy by the agent: effective when God is the subject (it creates the state), pronounced through prophets' tongues (5:78), and reciprocally hurled or conditionally invoked by creatures (7:38, 29:25, 2:159, 3:61, 24:7). It is gradable (laEnan kabiran, 33:68) and durative/pursuing (11:60, 28:42; ila yawm al-din, 15:35, 38:78), and is held Quran-internally distinct from anger (ghaDab) and from the separately-prepared torment (Eadhab).

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 41 occurrences the root names a verdict/status of being cast out and cut off — disowned, driven away, left with no helper (4:52), outlawed (33:61) — not the emotion of anger and not the punishment itself. The Quran itself keeps lEn separate by conjoining it WITH wrath and WITH a prepared torment (48:6, 4:93, 33:57). The verb is a transitive act done by an agent on an object; the noun laEnat is the lasting exclusion that rests upon and follows the target. The account is held at a relational altitude (not 'removal of a sinner from mercy') because the same root brands an inanimate object (the 'accursed tree', 17:60) and is used by powerless creatures who cannot enact expulsion.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: lEn does NOT entail: (1) anger/ghaDab — the two are conjoined as distinct items (48:6:16:2, 4:93:12:2, 5:60:11:1); (2) the inflicted torment/Eadhab — Eadhab is separately 'prepared/added' alongside the curse (33:57:6:1, 33:64:3:1, 9:68:12:2); (3) annihilation — the cursed persist and keep acting (4:118, 2:88); (4) a divine-only agent — communities and generic 'cursers' also lEn (7:38:17:1, 29:25:19:2, 2:159:20:2); (5) a necessarily verbal utterance — divine lEn is a decree grounded in kufr/covenant-breach (2:88:5:1, 5:13:4:1), utterance (5:78) being one mode; (6) confinement to the Hereafter — it operates fi al-dunya wa al-akhira (24:23:7:1, 33:57:6:1); (7) a moral-agent object — it can brand a tree (17:60:17:2); (8) a binary state — it is scalar (laEnan kabiran, 33:68:7:1). It also does NOT by itself fix whether the consignment is EFFECTED or merely INVOKED — that efficacy is supplied by the subject, not by the root; and it cannot be narrowed to 'removal from divine mercy of a culpable moral agent' (refuted by 17:60 and by the powerless damned as subjects in 29:25, 7:38).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 17:60:17:2 ٱلشَّجَرَةَ ٱلْمَلْعُونَةَ ('the accursed tree'): the target is an inanimate non-agent that has no favour, solidarity, support or mercy to be cut off from, so it refutes any narrowing of the nucleus to 'removal from divine mercy of a culpable moral agent' and forces the account to the thinner 'consigned/branded as reprobated and cast-off'. It does not shatter unity but disciplines the nucleus away from every theologically rich narrowing.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: The bivalent/effective-vs-invocative account (Adversary C): lEn is not one operation but two related-but-non-identical ones — (a) God/authoritative pronouncers EFFECT expulsion-severance, (b) creatures INVOKE/DECLARE it (liEan oath 24:7, mubahala 3:61, imperative-to-God 33:68, mutual cursing of the already-damned 7:38/29:25). Quran-internally nowhere is a creature's lEn demonstrated to be the same event-type as God's lEn; the root offloads its central truth-condition (does it land?) to the subject. This account is preferred over a pure speech-act 'imprecation' reading (which cannot carry the enduring status of 15:35/38:78 or the outlawry entailment of 33:61) but rivals the unified nucleus and is what keeps the grade off STRONG. It is bridged only by abstraction: the mubahala/liEan oaths (3:61, 24:7) are creatures invoking the DIVINE consignment, a clean hinge (2:159 places both readings under one surface form), and the verb is uniformly transitive-agent-on-object — so the two are one act at varying efficacy, not two senses. This bridge is coherent but not Quran-internally demonstrated as a single mechanism, hence a coherent resistant sub-class rather than adversarially-clean uniformity.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses independently converge on ONE relational nucleus (consign/brand as cast-out and cut off) and on MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE. The positive evidence is broad (41 occ.), cross-formal (perfect/imperfect/imperative/subjunctive/passive verb; verbal noun, cognate accusative, active participle, passive participle) and adversarially clean against the two main competitors: the recurrent ghaDab / laEn / Eadhab triad is the Quran itself distinguishing lEn from both anger and penalty (48:6, 4:93, 5:60, 33:57), and the no-helper (4:52), outlawry (33:61), pursuit (11:60, 28:42) and rests-upon (13:25, 40:52) co-text repeatedly fix its content as EXCLUSION/casting-out. Unity of the derivational family is itself STRONG (noun, masdar, both participles are regular deverbal expressions of the same act/state relation). But per the anti-over-grading rule the grade is capped at MODERATE + REPRESENTATIVE by (i) the inanimate/lexicalized passive-participle case 17:60 (which forbids any richer narrowing) and (ii) the coherent subject-keyed effective-vs-invocative sub-class whose truth-condition the root does not itself fix. Prefer the narrowest defensible account held at relational altitude; do not force the efficacy-parameter into a demonstrated single mechanism, but also do not split into unbridged senses since the transitive act/state relation and the mubahala/liEan hinge bind the family.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Deverbal state-noun laEnat = the enduring exclusion-status that RESTS UPON (Ealaa 11:18, 2:89, 7:44), is FOR the target (lahum al-laEnat 13:25, 40:52), ENDURES (ila yawm al-din 15:35, 38:78), and PURSUES/TRAILS the target (utbiEuu ... laEnatan 11:60, 11:99; atbaEnaahum ... laEnatan 28:42). Paired with deprivation of a good abode (suu' al-dar 13:25, 40:52) and co-agented by angels and mankind (2:161, 3:87).
clusters.classification_rationale: The state-face of the same nucleus: the realized/standing verdict of being cast-out. Syntax (Ealaa X / lahum / ila yawm al-din / utbiEuu laEnatan) fixes it as a durative burden of exclusion, not an emotion or an infliction.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 13:25:20:2 and 40:52:7:2 co-list laEnat with suu' al-dar as a distinct item; 15:35:3:2 and 38:78:3:1 give it a terminus (ila yawm al-din); 11:60:5:1 and 28:42:5:1 show it 'follows' the target. 3:61:22:1 (mubahala) and 24:7:3:1 (liEan oath) are nominal but INVOCATIVE and are flagged as adversarial boundaries.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Cognate accusative (maf'ul mutlaq) laEnan in wa-lEanhum laEnan kabiran = 'curse them a GREAT cursing' — the act/state is scalar, admitting magnitude.
clusters.classification_rationale: Directly evidences the gradability boundary: lEn is not binary. Reinforces the act-noun relation (the masdar of the imperative in the same verse, 33:68:6:2).
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 33:68:7:1 laEnan kabiran shows magnitude; consistent with the nucleus as a scalar verdict of exclusion.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: God as subject EFFECTS the consignment-to-exclusion. Entailments fix its content: no helper (fa-lan tajida lahu nasiran 4:52:6:1), cut off from guidance (fa-aSammahum wa-aEmaa abSaarahum 47:23), grounded in kufr/covenant-breach (bikufrihim 2:88/4:46; naqDihim mithaaqahum 5:13). Distinct from ghaDab (48:6, 4:93, 5:60) and from the separately-prepared Eadhab (33:57, 33:64, 9:68).
clusters.classification_rationale: The core act-face and the strongest, most distinctive evidence. The ghaDab/laEn/Eadhab conjunctions and the no-helper/incapacitation entailments make the nucleus narrow and non-vacuous.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 48:6:16:2, 4:93:12:2, 5:60:11:1 conjoin lEn with ghaDab (≠ anger); 33:57:6:1, 33:64:3:1, 9:68:12:2 pair it with a prepared Eadhab (≠ torment); 4:52:6:1 = no helper; 47:23:3:1 = deafened/blinded; 2:88:5:1 and 5:13:4:1 give the causal ground.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Non-divine agents perform the SAME relation at reduced efficacy: reciprocal repudiation among the damned (29:25 yalEanu baEDukum baEDan; 7:38 laEanat ukhtahaa), a standing class of human cursers (2:159 wa-yalEanuhumu al-laaEinuun), and a human imperative REQUESTING God to curse (33:68 wa-lEanhum). Here lEn = repudiate/disown/consign-to-exclusion (or invoke it), since these agents have no punitive power.
clusters.classification_rationale: Bridged to the core at relational altitude: the verb is transitive agent-on-object throughout, and 2:159 places creaturely and divine lEn under one surface form. Retained as CONSISTENT but flagged: the root does not itself fix whether the consignment is effected or merely invoked/declared — the subject supplies that. This is the coherent resistant sub-class that caps the grade at MODERATE.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 2:159:17:1 (divine) sits beside 2:159:19:2/2:159:20:2 (creaturely) in one verse, evidencing one relation at varying efficacy; the mubahala/liEan hinge (3:61, 24:7) shows creatures invoking the DIVINE consignment.
counterevidence: 3:61:22:1 فَنَجْعَل لَّعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ — a mubahala in which creatures INVOKE (do not enact) the divine consignment; efficacy is supplied by the divine referent, not by the root.
24:7:3:1 لَعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ — a conditional self-imprecatory liEan oath: nothing is enacted, only invoked contingently.
29:25:19:2 وَيَلْعَنُ بَعْضُكُم بَعْضًا — the already-damned lEn one another though they have no power to expel anyone, so here lEn is repudiation/disavowal, not enacted severance.
7:38:17:1 لَّعَنَتْ أُخْتَهَا — a nation curses its sister-nation in the Fire; a powerless agent, so lEn cannot mean 'to inflict expulsion' here.

2:159:20:2 وَيَلْعَنُهُمُ ٱللَّٰعِنُونَ placed beside يَلْعَنُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ in one verse: the identical form carries effective (divine) and merely-declarative (creaturely) readings, showing the root offloads the enacted/uttered truth-condition to the subject.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Agent-suppressed passive: the target is placed under the exclusion-verdict. 24:23 luEinuu fi al-dunya wa al-akhira (both realms); 5:64 wa-luEinuu bimaa qaaluu (grounded in their speech); 5:78 luEina ... Ealaa lisaani Dawuuda wa-Eisaa — the verdict PRONOUNCED through prophets' tongues, showing it can be verbally expressed yet is not merely an emotion.
clusters.classification_rationale: Passive of the same act; confirms both the durative dunya+akhira scope and the 'pronounced sentence' mode without changing the nucleus.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 5:78:1:1 (on the tongue of David and Jesus) confirms lEn is an enacted/pronounced verdict; 24:23:7:1 confirms fi al-dunya wa al-akhira.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Passive participle malEuun = the characterizing state of being cast-out/reprobated. 33:61 malEuuniina glosses the state by its consequence — OUTLAWRY: aynamaa thuqifuu ukhidhuu wa-quttiluu (wherever found, seized and killed) = withdrawal of protection, the sharpest confirmation of 'expulsion from the protected community'. 17:60 al-shajarata al-malEuunata applies the participle to an inanimate referent.
clusters.classification_rationale: 33:61 fits the nucleus cleanly (outlawry = enacted expulsion). 17:60 is the residual resistance: an inanimate object cannot lose relational standing, so it instantiates only the attenuated 'marked as reprobated' facet — handled via occurrence_override as final RESISTANT.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 33:61:1:1 (outlawed, hunted) is strong positive evidence for expulsion-from-protection; 17:60:17:2 is the strongest counterexample and is the sole final-RESISTANT occurrence.
counterevidence: 17:60:17:2 ٱلشَّجَرَةَ ٱلْمَلْعُونَةَ ('the accursed tree'): an inanimate non-agent with no favour/solidarity/support/mercy to be cut off from, resisting any relational narrowing of the nucleus.

reconciliation.rationale: Following Adversary C and the contract's anti-over-grading rule: an inanimate non-agent object refutes every richer narrowing and constitutes a coherent residual lexicalized case. It is bridged only at the thinnest altitude, so it is honestly recorded as final RESISTANT and is the reason the grade is capped at MODERATE rather than STRONG.

Retained as CONSISTENT (not final RESISTANT) because the verb is uniformly transitive agent-on-object and the mubahala/liEan oaths (3:61, 24:7) show creatures invoking the SAME divine consignment — a clean Quran-internal hinge. The efficacy difference is a parameter of one act, not a second sense. The unresolved efficacy-fixing is recorded as counterevidence and caps the grade, but does not warrant splitting into unbridged classes.

adversarial_verification.notes: The core account survives adversarial probing and is distinct from ghaDab and Eadhab, but the inanimate 17:60 resists and the effective-vs-invocative subject parameter is not resolved by the root itself; because some occurrences resist while the core holds, the attempt is recorded as NOT_RUN (not PASSED) with the residual resistance logged rather than claimed as a clean refutation-survival.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A, B, adversarial C) converged on the same nucleus and on the same two resistance points (17:60 inanimate; effective/invocative split), which cross-validates both the account and the residual resistance.
candidate_root_contribution: lEn = an authoritative act (verb) — or its resulting enduring state (noun laEnat) — of consigning/branding a target as cut off and cast out: repudiated and driven from favour, solidarity, support and (God's) mercy, and thereby left unsupported and marked. The same relation is realized at varying efficacy by the agent: effective when God is the subject (it creates the state), pronounced through prophets' tongues (5:78), and reciprocally hurled or conditionally invoked by creatures (7:38, 29:25, 2:159, 3:61, 24:7). It is gradable (laEnan kabiran, 33:68) and durative/pursuing (11:60, 28:42; ila yawm al-din, 15:35, 38:78), and is held Quran-internally distinct from anger (ghaDab) and from the separately-prepared torment (Eadhab).

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal occurrence in which lEn carries POSITIVE or NEUTRAL polarity (blessing, approval, or bare spatial motion with no repudiation), OR a divine lEn that is explicitly identified WITH ghaDab or WITH Eadhab (equated, not conjoined as a distinct item), would show the 'consign-to-exclusion/repudiation' nucleus is not the root's contribution.
rejection_condition.search_location: The conjunction environments 48:6:16:2, 4:93:12:2, 5:60:11:1 (lEn beside ghaDab) and 33:57:6:1 / 33:64:3:1 / 9:68:12:2 (lEn beside a separately-prepared Eadhab); every non-divine subject 7:38:17:1, 29:25:19:2, 2:159:20:2; and the inanimate 17:60:17:2.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each occurrence's verse_text and QAC morphology; test whether lEn can be substituted salva veritate by ghaDab or by Eadhab (it cannot, since they are conjoined with wa) and whether any occurrence carries approbation rather than repudiation.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Separate the root's contribution from co-text: causal grounds (kufr, covenant-breach), the prepared torment, the evil abode, and the day-of-judgment terminus are supplied by neighbouring words, not by lEn itself; do not import a 'punishment' reading from adjacent Eadhab.
